rows.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial choice for giving freely or generously.

example.english: They generously treated us to dinner.
example.jyutping: keoi5 daai6 fong1 gam3 ceng2 ngo5 dei6 sik6 faan6

rows.note: Use this when you want to emphasize notably generous giving, especially in donations or financial support.

example.english: They generously donated a large sum of money to the charity.
example.traditional: 佢慷慨咁捐咗一大筆錢畀慈善機構。
example.jyutping: keoi5 hong2 koi3 gam3 gyun1 zo2 jat1 daai6 bat1 cin4 bei2 ci4 sin6 gei1 kau3
